name: Bärenthal (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bärenthal (a blue bear on yellow above a yellow letter b on blue).
history: Arms and flag, proposed by the Staatsarchiv Sigmaringen in 1947, were granted by the Ministry of the Interior on 8 May 1957.

features.role: Bärenthal arms — blue bear and letter b
